xna-type.name: FrameworkDispatcher
xna-type.summary: Implements the Windows-specific portion of a FrameworkDispatcher class.

method.name: Update
method.summary: Updates the status of various framework components (such as power state and media) and raises related events. If your game does not use the Game class, you must call this method (the recommendation is once per frame) yourself.
